body.text: It falls to me, as it so often does, to tell you that your accounts are {perception:books}.
The Treasury has honoured {param:amount} on your word this year. It has begun to ask me what it is buying.
I have defended you. I want you to understand what that cost me.
I have not defended you. I did not think it would survive the attempt.

options.text: and note the pleasure you took in writing it
and confess I had hoped for longer
as I receive everything from you: badly

options.label: promise economy, and mean it
options.text: The colony will retrench. You may tell the Treasury as much over your own name{insert:barb}.

barb.hateful: , since you are so fond of carrying news

options.label: grant the Chancellor a favour for his trouble
options.text: Your trouble on my account is noted, and shall be repaid in kind.

grant_favor.favor: a word in the right ear

options.label: say nothing to the court
options.text: The court may think what it likes. It generally does.

tone.hateful: Do not write again unless the news is good.
